definitions.gloss: a pair; two people going together
definitions.explanation: Two people who are going somewhere or doing something together: friends, a couple, a parent and child.

examples.japanese: {二人連|ふたりづ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A party of two came in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二人連|ふたりづ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are lots of pairs in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧{二人連|ふたりづ}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧やら⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧らしい。
examples.english: The two walking ahead of us seem to be parent and child.

notes:
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧ + {連|づ}れ (companion). The same pattern gives {三人連|さんにんづ}れ (a party of three) and {親子連|おやこづ}れ (parent and child).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二人連|ふたりづ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: a party of two (in restaurants and shops)
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{二人連|ふたりづ}れ: a young pair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧: a romantic couple; {二人連|ふたりづ}れ says nothing about the relationship.
